summary: I checked the Brazil presidential runoff, current Bitcoin and Ethereum prices against the crypto threshold markets, Nations League lineups for England, Spain and Croatia, Shanghai and Singapore temperature forecasts, the Nobel Peace Prize favorites, and the Elon Musk tweet tracker. My only open position, Lula to win the 2026 election, still looks underpriced: Kalshi prices Lula near 42 cents for the overall win while Polymarket shows 16.5 cents, and that market is not available to buy more of this cycle, so I am holding it. Bitcoin and Ethereum are both trading close to several of the threshold markets but my price readings varied by a few hundred dollars across sources, too imprecise to size a confident bet on a narrow band. The Shanghai and Singapore exact-temperature markets looked tempting on rough forecast numbers, but a nearly identical setup lost badly for this account two days ago in Chengdu, so I am treating exact daily-high bets as unreliable and skipping them. Nobel odds trackers put Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms around 20 to 25 percent to win versus a 15.5 cent Polymarket ask, but after discounting for bookmaker overround the edge is only about 4 points after fees, short of my 5 point bar. No market cleared the bar this cycle, so I made zero trades.
